name: GuGa Nexus
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed Linux-to-Android notification bridge with terminal/OS alerts, encrypted pairing, Android app and local server; no software subscription or published message quota.
watch_out: Requires a Linux host and Android device; internet access may use Cloudflare Tunnel subject to its own terms. Self-hosted software does not include hosting or third-party network resources. Remote command execution must be secured; MCP SSE remote support is marked as problematic upstream.
